ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text:
As shown in the graph, the function 

\[
y = 
\begin{cases} 
3-x & (0 \le x \le 2)\\ 
x-1 & (2 \le x \le 4)
\end{cases}
\]

is illustrated. What is the minimum value of this function?
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Since the minimum value of the function is $(2,1)$, \\
therefore, the minimum value of the function is $\boxed{1}$.
